source.title: Hinterlands Mission VII: Recover Star-Touched Dragonegg
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Agol'watha. Retrieve a Star-Touched Dragonegg and deliver it to me.
source.objective: Recover a Star-Touched Dragonegg in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion from the central hut at Agol'wath and return to Field Captain Korlian.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
